Messages.Author: Dr. Enrique Montaño
Messages.Body:
1. Ian Forestal text explains that he can play cards requiring
superior level if he has a Master. What happens if he learns a
discipline via sanguine Instruction?

2. It souns silly, but majesty is solved before Carrion Crows' damage
is resolved, right?

3. If I dodge I still recieve the damge of carrion crows cause it
doesn´t come from a strike, right?

Thanks,
Enrique

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
"Dr. Enrique Montaño" <take...@yahoo.com> wrote in message
news:988915c.02021...@posting.google.com...

> 1. Ian Forestal text explains that he can play cards requiring
> superior level if he has a Master. What happens if he learns a
> discipline via sanguine Instruction?

He then has that discipline at the inferior level.
Card text.

> 2. It souns silly, but majesty is solved before Carrion Crows' damage
> is resolved, right?

Yes.
"... ends combat before other strikes can be
resolved or any damage dealt."

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/rulebook/rulebook.html#sec6_4_5

> 3. If I dodge I still recieve the damge of carrion crows cause it
> doesn´t come from a strike, right?

Correct.

Carpe noctem.
